decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several different types of backpacks: a budget-friendly laptop bag, a lightweight packable daypack, a premium tactical bag, a technical hiking pack, and a sports-specific bag. The HIKPRO 20L (prod_backpacks_006) was the most compelling option because it has an exceptionally high rating (4.7) from a large number of reviewers (over 2,800), and its price point of $17.99 makes it an excellent value for a durable, water-resistant travel and hiking daypack. While the KAILAS and Maxpedition bags are also high quality, the HIKPRO offers the best utility-to-price ratio for general use.
